Office hours are held **every Thursday, 9.15–10.15**, online via **Zoom**.

## How to book

Meetings are in **15-minute slots**. To book one, send an email to
[madshove@ps.au.dk](mailto:madshove@ps.au.dk) with your preferred time, and I will reply
with a Zoom link.

::: {.note-box}
**Please note:** I do not read any material before the meeting. Bring your questions — a
thesis idea, a draft, a methods problem, or a course question — and we will go through
them together during the slot.
:::
